Name: PRODUCE FLAME
Main Effect:
You conjure a small flickering flame in the palm of your hand, illuminating a 15-meter (50-foot) area around it.

Dropping the flame extinguishes it.
Secondary Effect:
You can spend 2 Action Points and 4 Willpower to hurl the flame at a target you can see within 15 meters (50 feet).

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - PRODUCE FLAME.jpg

Name: CLOAK OF FLAMES
Main Effect:
You envelop yourself in a fiery cloak that lasts for 5 turns.

Entities having their Turn Start within 1.5 meters (5 feet) of you take [[stat]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
You can spend 2 Action Points and 4 Willpower to make the cloak flare outward.

All entities within 3 meters (10 feet) of you are inflicted with Burn.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - CLOAK OF FLAMES.jpg

Name: KINDLE WEAPON
Main Effect:
You imbue a weapon you can touch with flames.

When the imbued weapon lands a hit, its damage is Empowered by 1 and the damage type becomes {damage:Fire}.
Secondary Effect:
At your Turn Start, you must pay 1 Willpower to keep the weapon kindled.

If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - KINDLE WEAPONS.jpg

Name: FIRE SEED
Main Effect:
You embed a seed of pure elemental fire in an entity you can see within 9 meters (30 feet). The target is unaware of the seed being placed if it does not see you cast the spell.

This effect lasts until the target takes a Long Rest, and for as long as it lasts you know the seed’s relative direction.
Secondary Effect:
If you have any active Fire Seed, you may pay 3 Action Points and 4 Willpower to detonate it.

All seeds explode, dealing [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in {damage} damage to the target and any entities within 4.5 meters (15 feet) of it.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - FIRE SEED.jpg

Name: MOLTEN GRASP
Main Effect:
You ignite your hands, gaining the ability to melt metal and stone with your touch for 5 turns.

For the duration of the spell, you can melt up to 1.5 square meters (5 square feet) of metal on a surface up to 15 cm (6 inches) thick.
Secondary Effect:
You can spend 2 Action Points and 3 Willpower to transfer the heat into a metallic object.

For the remainder of the spell duration, entities in contact with the object at their Turn Start take [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - MOLTEN GRASP.jpg

Name: WALL OF FLAMES
Main Effect:
You conjure a wall of fire at a location you can see within 15 meters (50 feet).

The wall is 15 meters (50 feet) long and 2 meters (6 feet) thick, and it does not have to be a straight line. The wall blocks line of sight.

Any entity passing through the wall or having their Turn Start within it takes [[4d6 + 4*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - WALL OF FLAMES.jpg

Name: BLAZING SUNS
Main Effect: You conjure 4 small spheres of fire that hover around you, illuminating 15 meters (50 feet) for 3 hours.
Secondary Effect:
Whenever you deal damage or heal, you can spend 1 Willpower to expend one of your spheres.

Doing so increases the damage or healing by [[2*stat]] in {damage} damage when applicable.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - BLAZING SUNS.jpg

Name: CAUTERIZE
Main Effect:
You use swift and intense heat to cauterize the wound of an entity you can see within 9 meters (30 feet).

The target takes [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage and then regains [[5d6 + 5*stat]] in Health. This removes any Bleed or Poison effect on the target.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Cauterize, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 3 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target an additional eligible entity with Cauterize.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - CAUTERIZE.jpg

Name: RAIN OF FIRE
Main Effect:
You call down a devastating rain of fire in a 12-meter (40-foot) radius centered on a point you can see within 30 meters (100 feet).

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Reflex of all entities in the area. On a success, you deal [[4d6 + 4*stat]] in {damage} damage, or half as much on a failure.

Another wave falls down at each of your Turn Starts for as long as you pay the Upkeep.
Secondary Effect:
At your Turn Start, you must pay 3 Willpower to keep the rain falling.

If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - FIRE - RAIN OF FIRE.jpg

Name: CONTROL WATER
Main Effect:
You gain control over water for the next 1 hour. You can manipulate water within 3 meters (10 feet) in the following ways:

Create Currents: You create currents within 3 meters (10 feet) that move objects and entities at a speed of your choice, up to 18 meters (60 feet) per turn.

Water Tension: You manipulate the tension of the water, allowing targets of your choice within 3 meters (10 feet) to walk on water.

Part Water: You can part a body of water, creating a sphere around you as large as 3 meters (10 feet), allowing you to walk underwater.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - CONTROL WATER.jpg

Name: CREATE WATER
Main Effect:
You condense the moisture in the air to create a small volume of water.

You create up to 2 liters (0.5 gallons) of water in an open container or on a surface you can see within 9 meters (30 feet).
Secondary Effect:
If there is at least 1 liter (0.25 gallons) of water within 9 meters (30 feet), you may spend 3 Action Points and 1 Willpower.

You hurl the water as a high-pressure beam at an entity within 9 meters (30 feet).

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - CREATE WATER.jpg

Name: ICE ARMOR
Main Effect:
You coat your body in a layer of protective frost that lashes out when shattered.

You gain [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in Shield.

When an attack causes you to lose Shield, an ice spike immediately fires at the attacker if they are within 9 meters (30 feet) and you can see them. The target takes [[1d6 + stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - ICE ARMOR.jpg

Name: DRAIN FLUIDS
Main Effect:
You reach out with your magical influence to siphon the internal liquids from a target entity you can see within 9 meters (30 feet).

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Grit.

On a success, the target takes [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage, and then again at each of your Turn Starts.
Secondary Effect:
At your Turn Start, you must pay 2 Willpower to keep siphoning. If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.

The spell effect also ends if you cannot see the target at your Turn Start.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - DRAIN FLUIDS.jpg

Name: FLASH FREEZE
Main Effect:
You release a sudden burst of freezing water to encase an entity you can see within 9 meters (30 feet) in a thin layer of ice.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Reflex. On a success, the target’s next Action is prevented.

This effect ends once the target attempts to take an Action.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - FLASH FREEZE.jpg

Name: TIDAL WAVE
Main Effect:
You create and send a tidal wave crashing onto your foes.

The wave starts at a point you can see within 24 meters (80 feet) and moves 12 meters (40 feet) in a direction of your choice. It is 9 meters (30 feet) wide and 3 meters (10 feet) tall.

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the Grit of all entities caught in its path. On a success, the entity is pushed 12 meters (40 feet).

If they encounter an obstacle before they are moved the full distance, they take [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - TIDAL WAVE.jpg

Name: GLACIAL ACCRETION
Main Effect:
For the next 5 turns, you manifest a freezing aura that crystallizes your spent energy into jagged shards of ice.

Every 2 Willpower you spend, you form an Ice Spike that orbits your body, up to a maximum equal to half your {mind}.
Secondary Effect:
You may spend 3 Action Points to hurl all active Ice Spikes at a single target you can see within 18 meters (60 feet).

Make a {mind} Ranged Attack {roll} against the target. On a hit, you deal [[1d6 + mind]] in {damage} damage for each Ice Spike consumed.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - GLACIAL ACCRETION.jpg

Name: ICE BLOCK
Main Effect:
You condense water and freeze it around a target entity you can see within 18 meters (60 feet).

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Reflex. On a success, the entity is encased in ice, becoming stunned and immune to all non-{damage:Psychic} damage.
Secondary Effect:
At your Turn Start, you must pay 4 Willpower to keep the ice frozen.

If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - ICE BLOCK.jpg

Name: WATER VORTEX
Main Effect:
You manifest a swirling vortex of water at a point you can see within 9 meters (30 feet) that lasts for 10 turns (1 minute).

The vortex has a 15-meter (50-foot) radius and the area is considered Difficult Terrain.

At each entity’s Turn Start within the area, make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Grit. On a success, the entity is pulled 9 meters (30 feet) toward the center of the vortex.

You make the roll with 1 Disadvantage against entities with a height of 3 meters (10 feet) or more, and 1 more for every 1.5 meters (5 feet) of height over it.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WATER - WATER VORTEX.jpg

Name: AIR CONTROL
Main Effect:
You control air density in a 15-meter (50-foot) area centered on yourself.

When you cast it, you choose to make the air:

Dense: Doubling the Action Point cost of the {{Move}} action for all entities within range and granting them the Slow Fall effect for 10 turns (1 minute).

Light: Increases all entities’ Movement Speed by 3. Outside of combat, it increases how much you can travel by foot by 50%.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - AIR - AIR CONTROL.jpg

Name: FLING
Main Effect:
You use strong force to instantly displace yourself to a point you can see within 15 meters (50 feet).

If you would collide with an obstacle before reaching your destination, you stop and take [[6d6]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Fling, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target an additional entity within touch to move the same distance in the same direction.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - AIR - FLING.jpg

Name: WIND BLADE
Main Effect:
You launch a sharp wind blade at an entity you can see within 15 meters (50 feet).

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[2d6 + stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - AIR - WIND BLADE.jpg

Name: HURL
Main Effect:
You create a strong gust of wind in an attempt to hurl an entity you can see within 9 meters (30 feet).

Make a {stat} Roll {roll} against the target’s Grit. On a success, the entity is moved 9 meters (30 feet) in a direction of your choice.

If the entity collides with another entity, both take [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage and the movement stops.
Image: ADEPT SPELL - ELEMENTAL - WIND - HURL.jpg

Name: LIGHTNING STRIKE
Main Effect:
You call down lightning to strike a point you can see within 9 meters (30 feet).

If the space is occupied by an entity, make a {stat} Roll {roll} against its Reflex. On a success, you deal [[2d6 + 2*stat]] in {damage} damage, or half as much on a failure.

If you used Lightning Strike in the last 12 hours, the last point you struck with lightning is also struck.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - LIGHTNING - LIGHTNING STRIKE.jpg

Name: VOLTAIC JOLT
Main Effect:
You turn into pure energy and instantly teleport yourself to a point you can see within 6 meters (20 feet).

All entities in a line between your start and end point take [[1d6 + stat]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
You can spend 1 Action Point and 2 Willpower to teleport any number of entities you can touch along with you.

They move the same distance parallel to you.
Image: ADEPT  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - LIGHTNING - LIGHTNING STRIKE.jpg

Name: GALVANIZE
Main Effect:
You touch an entity, infusing them with volatile electrical energy that reacts to impacts.

A target entity you can touch becomes Galvanized.

Whenever a Galvanized entity is hit, a spark erupts which deals an additional [[stat]] in {damage} damage to them.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Galvanize, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 4 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, target an additional eligible entity with Galvanize.
Image: MASTER  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - LIGHTNING - GALVANIZE.jpg

Name: SLAG SHOT
Main Effect:
You fire a small orb of magma at an entity you can see within 15 meters (50 feet).

Make a {stat} Ranged Attack {roll}. On a hit, you deal [[1d6 + stat]] in {damage} damage and the target is afflicted with Burn.
Secondary Effect:
When casting Slag Shot, you may spend an additional 1 Action Point and 1 Willpower any number of times.

For each time you do, cast Slag Shot an additional time.
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - MAGMA- SLAG SHOT.jpg

Name: MAGMA CHAINS
Main Effect:
Chains made of magma erupt from the ground, binding an entity you can see within 6 meters (20 feet).

The entity is bound by 3 Chains. It can spend 2 Action Points to attempt to break a Chain by making a {physique} roll against your {stat}. On a success, it breaks 1 Chain. On a critical success, it breaks 2 Chains.

While 3 Chains remain, the target is stunned and can only attempt to break Chains. While 2 or fewer Chains remain, the target is rooted.

At its Turn Start, the entity takes [[stat]] in {damage} damage.
Image: ADEPT  SPELL - ELEMENTAL - MAGMA- MAGMA CHAINS.jpg

Name: MAGMA SURGE
Main Effect:
You call forth molten rock to flood at a point you can see within 18 meters (60 feet), creating a 9-meter (30-foot) radius pool of magma that is considered Difficult Terrain.

Any entity entering the area or having their Turn Start within it takes [[3d6 + 3*stat]] in {damage} damage.
Secondary Effect:
At your Turn Start, you must pay 2 Willpower to keep the magma molten. If you do not pay the Upkeep, the spell effect ends.

When the spell ends, the magma solidifies into stone, and all creatures currently in the area become rooted until their next Turn End.
Image: MASTER SPELL - ELEMENTAL - MAGMA- MAGMA SLIDE.jpg

Name: SHAPE EARTH
Main Effect:
You reach out with your mind, causing earth, mud or stone to flow like thick liquid into a shape of your choosing.

You reshape a 3-meter (10-foot) cube of earth or stone you can see within 9 meters (30 feet) into a new form (such as a wall, a pillar or a simple stone object).

The object has a Defense equal to [[stat + level]] and Health equal to [[5*stat]].
Image: NOVICE SPELL - ELEMENTAL - EARTH - SHAPE EARTH.jpg
